sections.title: Unit 32: The Judiciary and the Rule of Law, 2011–2026
body: Between 2011 and 2026 the organisation of the Hungarian courts changed several times: new judicial laws, a new central office, a council of judges and European procedures on the rule of law. Each step was welcomed by some and criticised by others, in Hungary and abroad.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: obligation in the past, nouns for procedures, concession, time frames and reported statements. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
